m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Adept Morganthe, do you know why you were sent here? Can you fathom the chaos and pain you caused? What toll you almost cost us?
<ITALICS>Of course I know why I'm here, you prattling fool. I failed. Not for breaking the rules, but because I bungled it openly. </ITALICS>
If it had not been for the swift intervention and ceaseless aid of Sylvia and myself, Wizard City might be a smoldering ruin.
You think the Astral schools are playthings, and the Spiral worlds a game board or laboratory to practice upon?
<ITALICS>Aren't they? Someone needs to understand the boundaries of the Spiral. And figure out which rules can be bent, and which broken. </ITALICS>
Your punishment is a suspension of magical studies for the immediate future. Give me your Wand.
<ITALICS>What!? My Wand! You pompous, arrogant, stuffed shirt! I'll give you my Wand. </ITALICS>
You are skilled, but there is much left for you to learn, impudent child!
Enough! What is going on here? Malistaire, Morganthe, enough of this madness!
Headmaster, I was only teaching Morganthe how little she knows.
Malistaire, I expected you to handle this prudently. Not to wage war on each other.
And Morganthe... oh, Morganthe.
You disappoint me.
Never mind, Malistaire. Asking you to censure Morganthe was my failing. As was my inability to teach her caution and mercy.
Morganthe, for placing Ravenwood in dire jeopardy, and for your utter lack of remorse, there can be only one punishment.
I must take away your wand and your deck of spells...
<ITALICS>No, no, n-n-no don't you dare, don't you think that you can do this to me for one second, I won't let you, I can't live without my magic! </ITALICS>
...and expel you from Ravenwood. May you find your true self, out in the Spiral.
<ITALICS>Noooo! </ITALICS>
We must all learn our lessons from this tragic series of events, or else we will be doomed to repeat them.
You look pale and unsteady. Will you be alright?
Enter the second Chamber of the Mind. Another time, another place, another dream.
Remember, these are true things, but Morganthe's age and temperament color them.
Enter the second Chamber of the Mind and experience Morganthe's dream.
